text:
Maya: Quick design review — I ran through the new key creation stepper in the console. Step 2 (permissions) is easy to skip because it's visually the same as metadata. users are missing the scope toggles. Sam: Saw that in user testing too. They hit Next then complain the key can't do X. Can we make the scopes section more prominent? maybe a bordered box + short hint 'Who can use this key?' Olivia: Accessibility note: the 'this key will not be shown again' text is not read by screen readers. It's plain text below the input — add aria-describedby on the token field and make the notice aria-live=polite when created. Jordan: Copy question — should the primary CTA be 'Create key' or 'Create and copy key'? My vote: explicit 'Create key' then show the token block with a clear Copy button. auto-copy feels surprising. Maya: +1 for not auto-copying. Also the token display should have a short TTL reveal — mask by default and only show when user clicks Reveal; then hide after 30s. mention that in the copy. Sam: Revoke flow: people accidentally hit revoke during experiments. Add an undo snackbar for 10s after revoke. Also consider adding a soft-revoke state for test projects so production keys don't get nuked by mistake. Olivia: Rotate modal UX: current steps are Generate -> Update apps -> Revoke old. Testers expected rotate to revoke old automatically after they confirmed 'done updating'. We should explicitly surface an 'Overlap period (minutes/hours/days)' control. Jordan: A11y nit: the stepper is implemented as a set of buttons but lacks aria-current on the active step — screen readers announce them as clickable without indicating progress. Add aria-current and role="progressbar" with value now/total. Ben: Suggestion for revoke modal copy: instead of generic 'Are you sure?' try 'This will immediately stop all traffic using this key. You can undo for 10s.' makes consequences clearer and reduces panic. Maya: Empty state: when no keys exist show a sample snippet (monospace) and a single primary CTA 'Create key' plus a secondary 'How keys & scopes work' link. Also show suggested presets: Read-only, Embeddings-only, Full-access. Sam: UI pattern: long scope lists are overwhelming. Use chips with quick presets and a 'More...' accordion for advanced scopes. that should cut cognitive load. Olivia: Small copy tweak: change header 'Scopes' to 'Permissions (Scopes)' — testers understood that better. Jordan: Backend/FE sync: rotate API returns new key only once — front-end must not re-call endpoints that would fail. Add test to ensure the token is surfaced exactly once. Ben: Layout nit — on narrow screens the token block wraps awkwardly. Use a monospace horizontal scroll container instead of wrapping to multiple lines. Maya: Security: show an 'Issued by' badge (project/org) near each key so users know billing/ownership. People confuse service account keys and user keys. Sam: Shortcut idea: add a small 'download .env' with the token inserted for common runtimes (node, python, ruby) after create. saves a step for developers. Olivia: Another a11y thing: rotate modal's confirm button is visually primary but not focusable in DOM order — keyboard users have to tab through the whole list first. Ensure primary CTA is the last focus in the modal and gets initial focus when appropriate. Jordan: QA checklist I'm adding to PR template: aria-current for steppers, aria-describedby on token notice, keyboard focus order, visible undo snackbar for revoke. deploy-bot: Deployed branch ux/key-stepper-a11y to staging @ 2024-11-02T14:23Z :rocket: Ben: I'll run through staging tomorrow morning and jot down any visual tweaks. Maya: I'll update the Figma with permission-chip patterns + copy variants (three CTA options). Will DM the copy list. :thumbsup: Sam: thanks — this feels like a good set of changes. Jordan: tagging @Olivia to help with aria wording examples. Olivia: happy to — I'll add exact aria attributes and sample HTML snippets in the PR comment.
